digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init must not create an empty orphan branch when the configured remote is reachable but the fetch fails or times out

a tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote must distinguish advertised (return 0), reachable-absent (return 2), and unreachable (timeout/other error) states, and be cached per resolved repo/remote/branch with a short TTL
init must fail closed with actionable diagnostics when the remote is unreachable or times out, and never enter the interactive consent gate during strict auto-init in this state

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable remotes as do-not-auto-mount, return without error, and never supply force_new_store=True; the following strict path reuses the cached tri-state result

the --force-new-store flag and force_new_store=True keyword must permit deliberate orphan bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established; when the remote is reachable, the flag has no effect and warns

all four consumers (_mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, _create_tracker) must share one probe result and never invoke a second independent remote-existence check
